item.title: Announcing LTC Italian Old Style Pro from the Lanston Type Company
item.description: LTC Italian Old Style was originally released by P22/Lanston Type Company in 2006. The font, based on Frederic Goudy’s interpretation of Nicholas Jenson’s Roman face as well as other Renaissance Roman faces, has been newly updated by James Grieshaber for the Lanston Type Company. LTC Italian Old Style Pro is now offered as a pro font family containing 4 styles- Regular, Italic, Light and Light Italic. OpenType features include the original ligatures, small caps and expanded language coverage. The Roman styles, Regular and Light, also welcome the addition of ornaments.
